factual_and_methodological.summary: PIF primary material confirms the 2026-2030 three-portfolio strategy, six domestic ecosystems, more than US$900bn AUM, more than US$199bn domestic investment from 2021-2025 and PIF-reported cumulative contribution above US$342bn to real non-oil GDP. The dossier correctly treats the impact figures as self-reported measures requiring an additionality test rather than as causal estimates.

editorial_publication_readiness.opening: Direct mechanism-led opening; no generic sophistication claims or product-process narration.
editorial_publication_readiness.headings: Headings advance the actor-specific mechanism, constraints, contrary evidence and revision conditions.
editorial_publication_readiness.language_localization: EN and PT-BR are semantically aligned; PT-BR technical prose was localized before approval.
editorial_publication_readiness.cohesion: Argument moves from rights/capability through transmission, constraints and evidence that would revise the assessment.
editorial_publication_readiness.template_meta_qa: No prompt, QA-process, schema, renderer or roadmap leakage detected.

contextual_depth.summary: The dossier distinguishes legal rights, operating capability, transmission, substitutability and institutional constraints rather than relying on scale or reputation.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: At least two analytical tables, one quantitative chart, one causal flow and one mind map in both locales.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: Visuals encode sourced quantities or mechanisms defended in prose and are not combined into a synthetic power score.

contrary_evidence: Large public expenditure can create demand without establishing commercially durable productive capacity.
Private co-investment, external sales and cash generation may fail to scale even when project construction and sovereign capital deployment are large.
limitations: Economy-wide additionality cannot be inferred from PIF's reported contribution metrics without a counterfactual.
Project-level motives and geopolitical transmission require transaction-specific evidence rather than inference from sovereign ownership.
notes: Dedicated single-actor Strategic Actors dossier. Primary-source factual core, controlled taxonomy, bilingual parity and visual evidence reviewed; no public bundle for this ID at approval time.

en.title: PIF: sovereign capital as a bridge between Saudi public wealth and domestic productive capacity
en.deck: PIF's stated mandate combines financial returns with Saudi economic transformation. Its structural relevance comes from the ability to finance and coordinate long-duration domestic investment; the key uncertainty is whether that capital produces durable additional private capacity.
en.regime: Sovereign capital is being reorganized around three portfolios with greater emphasis on domestic ecosystems, capital efficiency and private-sector participation.
en.key_risk: Large public investment can be mistaken for durable productive additionality before project economics, utilization and private reinforcement are demonstrated.

pt-BR.title: PIF: capital soberano como ponte entre riqueza pública saudita e capacidade produtiva doméstica
pt-BR.deck: O mandato declarado do PIF combina retorno financeiro e transformação econômica saudita. Sua relevância vem da capacidade de financiar e coordenar investimento doméstico de longa duração; a principal incerteza é quanto isso gera capacidade privada adicional e durável.
pt-BR.regime: O capital soberano está sendo reorganizado em três portfólios com maior ênfase em ecossistemas domésticos, eficiência de capital e participação privada.
pt-BR.key_risk: Grande investimento público pode ser confundido com adicionalidade produtiva durável antes de economia dos projetos, utilização e reforço privado serem demonstrados.
watch: reciclagem de capital e custos de funding
